This [[Gender/Legends|woman]] was the commanding officer of the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']] first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]'', in which she was voiced by [[Lynne McClean]]. The character is not named in the game, and is not shown, with only her voice heard over the [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] during missions.
